name: Anettai Chuuihou!?
source:
The main character lost his parents when he was a kid. Since then, he has been living with his older sister. 

But one day, he is separated from her due to some reasons. He, who is now in sackcloth and ashes, enters new school, but it is actually an all-girls' school. He is the one and only male student there! 
Surrounded by older students, his sex-filled school life begins...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角小时候就失去了父母。从那时起，他就一直和姐姐住在一起。

但有一天，他却因为某些原因与她分开了。如今麻衣灰烬的他，进入了新的学校，但那实际上是一所女子学校。他是那里唯一的男学生！
在高年级学生的包围下，他充满性的校园生活开始了……

[来自工口游戏商店]
